narrative.overview: Tenface is a ledger that the owner reads in a few seconds. Every project, lane, task and step is written down in warm, paper-like Sepia tones, in tables and trees that read like a well-kept book. The page does not glow or decorate. Its one color, a blood red, says "this runs now". What the agents ask the owner does not sit on the page. Each question belongs to the agent that asked it: the planner of the project (P) or the babysitter of a lane (B). The agent is a ring that shows its context use, and a small card on the ring counts its open questions. Tap the ring and its card lists the questions. The owner answers in that agent's chat, for example "Q12 ok". The surface is light Sepia by day and dark Sepia by night. There is no accent color. Shapes follow Apple's current capsule forms without the glass. The phone answers "what now"; the desktop shows project, lane and task side by side.
keyCharacteristics: The trio: done is a filled gray square, running a filled red square, waiting an empty square with a gray outline; it counts tasks, and lanes in a project row.
Red means running and nothing else; a question is a count on the asking agent's ring.
Every question has an id (Q12) that is unique across the whole system.
Ink marks where the owner is: the current tab, the selected row, the selected desktop lane.
An error of the whole panel is an ink strip at the top of every screen.
A plan change is read-only; the owner answers it in the planner's chat.
A lane is one tree with lines from root to leaf.

rules.name: The Red Means Running Rule
rules.body: Red marks what runs now and nothing else. No red for a question, an error, a link, a brand or decoration.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no second color. Selection, focus and "current" are shown with ink, weight and tone.

rules.name: The Ink Means Here Rule
rules.body: Ink marks where the owner is: the current tab has a 1.5 px ink border, a selected tree row a 2 px ink outline, and the selected lane row in the desktop lanes table an ink fill. In a plan change, a 1 px ink outline marks an added row and the box of a new lane.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: Only 12, 14, 16, 20 and 28 px exist, except the 9 px mark inside a small icon: the letter or count of an agent icon and the "?" of the question card in a tree row. A long title wraps; it is never cut.

rules.name: The Last Pick Rule
rules.body: The desktop detail column shows the last pick. The picked task keeps a 2 px ink outline; the selected lane row has the ink fill while its task is shown, and only a 2 px outline while the detail column shows a plan change.

rules.name: The Error Rule
rules.body: An error of the whole panel is an ink strip at the top of every screen; an error of one thing stays in place; a button only when the owner's action fixes it.

rules.name: The Offline Rule
rules.body: Offline, the panel shows the last known state under the strip: the trio and the ring keep their last colors, and the strip alone says the panel is offline. Only the running node turns into a 2 px gray outline and its step tile turns gray.

rules.name: The Flat Unless Floating Rule
rules.body: No shadow on anything that lies in the page; only the nav, the agent ring, the agent card and the task sheet float. On the phone, behind an open agent card or the task sheet, the page and the nav are dimmed with ink at 32%.

dos: Do count tasks with the trio everywhere: done, running, waiting.
Do put a question in the card of the agent that asked it, with its id and the waiting time.
Do close a question when the owner answers it in the chat: a hook in the asking agent's session (the babysitter's or the planner's) tells the server, and the row leaves the card.
Do show the agent on every lane and project page, and let the owner drag it out of the way.
Do show a plan change before it is applied, with + − → ~ signs.
Do give every focusable element a 2 px ink focus ring with a 2 px offset.
Do write times as "11:20" for today and "Nov 13, 20:30" for another day.
donts: Don't use red for a question, an error or anything that does not run.
Don't add an accent color, a gradient, glass, blur or a second attention color.
Don't put a list of questions on a page; questions live in the agent card.
Don't write a state word next to an agent; the ring says it.
Don't add Approve or Reject to a plan change.
Don't use a font size outside 12, 14, 16, 20 and 28 px, or cut a title with "…".
Don't draw drag handles or drop zones for tasks; the tree is never edited by hand.
Don't use real client, project or task names in designs or code; sample data is made up.
